about_the_game:
Explore, investigate and unravel the secrets buried in time. As psychic Amber Lopez, navigate haunted grounds, decipher ancient runes, and piece together the puzzle of a decades-old murder, each discovery closing in on a truth she’s not ready to face.

FEATURES

Explore Through Amber’s Eyes

Use psychic abilities to connect with the dead, uncover hidden truths, and experience memories left behind.

Wander the Haunted Past

Move through forgotten homes, overgrown graveyards, and shadowed paths steeped in buried secrets.

Solve Twisted Puzzles

Crack logic-based challenges—from rune translation to graveyard puzzles—using memory, deduction, and intuition.

Uncover a Cold Case

Piece together the tangled truth behind a decades-old double murder lost to silence and time.

Listen for What Lurks

Use spatial audio to sense Doomshades—malignant spirits trapped between realms—creeping just out of sight.

content_descriptors.notes: This game features psychological horror themes, including murder, grief, supernatural entities, and references to witchcraft. It contains disturbing imagery, emotional trauma, and scenes of violence and possession. Player discretion is advised.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64 Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K | AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1070 Ti or AMD Radeon™ RX 5700 or Intel® Arc™ A750
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: Playing on minimum requirements should enable to play on Low/Medium quality settings in Full HD (1080p) in stable 30 FPS. SSD is recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64 Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K | AMD Ryzen 5 3600X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® 3080RTX or AMD Radeon™ 6900XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: Playing on recommended requirements should enable to play on Medium quality settings in 60 FPS or High quality settings in 30 FPS, in FullHD (or 4k using DLSS or similar technology). SSD is recommended
